title: Tableau v4: copy-and-swap assignment (slides 111–112)
expectedStdout:
tab2.get(3) = 3, tab3.get(3) = 3
after tab3.get(3) = -1: tab2.get(3) = 3
self-assignment ok: 3
tryThis: Self-assignment (`tab2 = same;`, where `same` aliases `tab2`) is handled correctly by copy-and-swap, with no special case. Writing `tab2 = tab2;` directly also works, but clang warns because it is almost always a typo.
